children: New Delhi, Sept. 7 -- PC Jeweller share price surged 15% in intraday deals on the BSE on Monday, 7 September, defying weak stock market sentiment. PC Jeweller shares opened at Rs.12.12 against their previous close of Rs.11.90 and jumped 14.7% to an intraday high of Rs.13.65, looking set to extend gains for the third consecutive session.
